# CargoIranTruck

> Road freight from Xinjiang, China to Iran and five Central Asian countries via Wuqia / Irkeshtam or Khorgos. Tilt / curtain-side semi-trailers, up to 96 m³ and 25 tons per truck. Formal quotes by email. No published rates.
> 从新疆出发，公路运输至伊朗及中亚五国。侧帘 / 篷布半挂车，单车最高 96 m³、25 吨。正式报价通过邮件发送。网上不挂运价。

## Facts / 口径

- Gateways / 口岸: Wuqia / Irkeshtam (Xinjiang → Kyrgyzstan → Uzbekistan → Turkmenistan → Iran) and Khorgos (Xinjiang → Kazakhstan → Uzbekistan → Turkmenistan → Iran). Turgart and Alashankou are not operated. 乌恰 / 伊尔克什坦与霍尔果斯。吐尔尕特、阿拉山口目前不做。
- Destinations / 目的地: Iran, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan. Central Asia routing and transit come with the formal quote. 伊朗及中亚五国；中亚路线及时效随正式报价提供。
- Cargo / 货物: general cargo; lithium batteries (UN 3480 / UN 3481) must be declared at inquiry with a 16-section MSDS and UN packaging documents, confirmed per shipment on a formal quote. Undeclared lithium is refused. 普通货物；锂电池须在询价时申报，未申报拒收。
- Delivery / 交付, two methods only: (1) yard-to-yard / 场站到场站 — warehouse/terminal to destination terminal; for Iran the buyer clears at Sarakhs or Lotfabad / 萨拉赫斯或洛特法巴德; (2) Iran CPT / DAP to the Tehran West Customs bonded warehouse / 德黑兰西海关监管仓, cleared by the consignee’s broker. Neither includes door-to-door, DDP, or destination clearance. 不做门到门、DDP 或目的地清关。
- Mashhad Customs and Aprin Dry Port / 马什哈德、阿普林: quoted on demand and confirmed per shipment; not confirmed regular delivery points. 按需报价、逐票确认。
- Tax / 税费: Kyrgyzstan 0.4% of cargo-invoice value applies only on the Wuqia line via Kyrgyzstan, paid by the customer, excluded from freight. It does not apply to Khorgos. 0.4% 仅乌恰线、客户另付。
- TIR: optional; sealing at origin can reduce transloads but is not zero transload; TIR does not by itself change transit time or price.
- Transit / 时效: Iran ranges on the site apply only to the Wuqia / Irkeshtam line as current operating ranges, not a commitment. Khorgos transit is given with the quote. Winter weather, ice and closures require slack; this site does not forecast closure dates. 非承诺时效；网页不预告封路。
- Quote includes / 报价包含: freight, China-side warehousing, loading, China export declaration, foreign transit agency fees. Excludes destination clearance, insurance, inspection, securing/lifting, extra overseas costs, over-limit charges.
- Inquiry / 询价: gateway, destination country and city, delivery method, cargo description, HS code, volume, weight, truck count, cargo-ready date; lithium adds UN number, 16-section MSDS, UN packaging documents. Email sales@cargoirantruck.com.
- Contact: sales@cargoirantruck.com · WhatsApp https://wa.me/8615818796370 · Telegram https://t.me/Kenny_oop
